content.title: Elastic Earnings Beat Estimates. The Stock Is Falling Anyway.
content.summary: Elastic  stock dropped Friday after the search-and-data analytics company reported mixed quarterly results that left some investors confused.  The company late Thursday posted adjusted earnings of 64 cents a share for its fiscal second quarter, surpassing the consensus estimate of 58 cents among analysts tracked by FactSet.  The stock had fallen 17% this year as of Thursday’s close.
